title: haex-hive project marker
description: Canonical shape for .haex-hive.json in a haex-hive-opted-in repository. Draft for Spec 004 — the authoritative file is committed at .specify/schemas/haex-hive.schema.json when Spec 004 is implemented.

identity.description: Device-independent project identity. Git remote URL for git-backed projects, or local:<name> placeholder before a remote exists.

identity_note.description: Optional free-text explanation of the identity value (e.g., 'placeholder while unpushed').

harness_sources.description: Unified array of role-carrying pointers AND permission-only trust scopes. See entry shapes below. An empty array declares opt-in with no permissions — every reference including 'self' is refused.

groups.description: Reserved for Phase 2/3 group definitions. Currently must be an empty array in this repo.

active_feature.description: Optional active-feature pointer for spec-kit workflows. Kept as-is from Spec 003.

role.description: Named role slot. Phase 1: only 'constitution'. Widening this enum is a PATCH-level constitution change.

revision.description: Full Git SHA, 7-40 lowercase hex chars. No branch or HEAD references. Must not be the literal string 'self'.

path.description: Single repo-relative path. Only used by role-carrying entries.

paths.description: Path allowlist for permission-only entries. Non-empty array of repo-relative paths.

allOf.description: Role-carrying constraint: if role present, revision AND path required, paths forbidden.
Permission-only constraint: if role absent, path forbidden and repository must not be 'self'.

repository_value.description: Either the reserved literal 'self' (magic keyword meaning 'this repo, no network') OR a Git URL using an accepted scheme.

oneOf.description: URL with accepted scheme: https://, ssh://, or SCP-style user@host:path.
